tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
TP-Link Archer C54 AC1200 Dual-Band Wi-Fi Router – Fast, Reliable Internet for Your Home

The TP-Link Archer C54 AC1200 Dual-Band Wi-Fi Router is designed to deliver fast and reliable internet for all your devices, making it perfect for homes, small offices, and everyday internet activities like HD streaming, gaming, and browsing. With AC1200 speed, it provides up to 300 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band and 867 Mbps on the 5 GHz band, ensuring stable and uninterrupted connections.


Key Features:

  • Dual-Band Wi-Fi (2.4GHz + 5GHz): Enjoy fast and stable Wi-Fi speeds for seamless streaming, gaming, and browsing.
  • MU-MIMO Technology: Multiple devices can connect simultaneously without slowing down, perfect for smart homes and families with multiple devices.
  • Beamforming Technology: Focuses the Wi-Fi signal directly to your devices for enhanced coverage and stronger connections.
  • Easy Setup with Tether App: Set up your router and manage your network from your smartphone with the user-friendly TP-Link Tether app.
  • Parental Controls: Keep your family safe online with customizable parental controls and guest network access.
  • Ideal for Homes & Small Offices: Perfect for multiple users and devices, supporting smooth 4K streaming, video conferencing and more.
  • Upgrade to the TP-Link Archer C54 for fast, reliable, and secure Wi-Fi across all your devices, providing a seamless internet experience for everyone in your home or office.
